name: What are special assessments, and how do they relate to HOA fees and my investment?

mainEntity.name: What are special assessments, and how do they relate to HOA fees and my investment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Special assessments are additional, one-time fees levied by an HOA on its members, typically for unforeseen major repairs or capital improvements not covered by the regular budget or reserve funds. While distinct from recurring HOA fees, they can significantly impact your investment's immediate profitability and cash flow. It's important to review HOA meeting minutes and financial disclosures to identify any upcoming or pending special assessments before purchasing a property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Special assessments are extra, one-time HOA fees for major repairs or improvements. They can significantly impact an investment's immediate cash flow.
